puzzle.hint: A moment of forgiveness and mercy in the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph).
puzzle.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
